plainTranslation: The Neptune person can blur the Mars person's desire, anger, and action. Heat may fizzle into avoidance or indirect conflict. Say what you want plainly, and notice when the body is reacting to uncertainty.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their idealism, vagueness, and dreams press against your drive, timing, and willingness to act.
summaryDeep: Their idealism, vagueness, and dreams press against your drive, timing, and willingness to act. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
